```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}
#remove old incorrect mom_education
df$mom_education <- NULL

#rename sex, birth date variables
df <- df %>%
rename(c(mom_education = GRAVEDUC))

df <- rename(df, sex = SD2)

# calculate age from start date and birth date
df <- df %>% 
  mutate(
    StartDate = ymd_hms(StartDate),
    StartDateOnly = as_date(StartDate),
    dob_raw = mdy(SD1),
    dob = if_else(dob_raw > StartDateOnly,
                  dob_raw - years(100), dob_raw),
    age_days = as.numeric(StartDateOnly - dob, units = "days"),
    age_years = age_days/365.25
  )

# recode maternal education variable
df$mom_education <- recode(df$mom_education, '0'=0, '1'=0, '2'=1, '3'=2, '4'=2, '5'=2, '6'=2, '7'=0)
```

# Hierarchical Regression Analyses
#Hierarchical regression models were implemented for each cytokine and region-of-interest separately for each trimester (i.e., one cytokine was included in each model).

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

#create a function for the hierarchical linear regressions

hr <- function(data, outcome, predictor, covar) {
  # Combine variables needed
  vars <- c(outcome, covar, predictor)
  # Remove rows with missing data
  df_clean <- na.omit(data[, vars])
  # Create formulas
  base_formula <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", paste(covar, collapse = " + ")))
  full_formula <- as.formula(paste(outcome, "~", paste(c(covar, predictor), collapse = " + ")))
  # Fit models
  model1 <- lm(base_formula, data = df_clean)
  model2 <- lm(full_formula, data = df_clean)
  #Bootstrap, 5000 iterations
  set.seed(123)
  n_iter <- 5000
  results <- data.frame(r2_diff = numeric(n_iter),
                        adjr2_diff = numeric(n_iter),
                        coef_pred = numeric(n_iter))
  
  for (i in 1:n_iter) {
    boot_indices <- sample(nrow(df_clean), replace = TRUE)
    boot_data <- df_clean[boot_indices, ]
    base_boot <- lm(base_formula, data = boot_data)
    full_boot <- lm(full_formula, data = boot_data)
    results$r2_diff[i] <- summary(full_boot)$r.squared - summary(base_boot)$r.squared
    results$adjr2_diff[i] <- summary(full_boot)$adj.r.squared - summary(base_boot)$adj.r.squared
    results$coef_pred[i] <- coef(full_boot)[which(names(coef(full_boot)) == predictor)]
  }
  #p-value
  pval <- 2 * min(
  mean(results$coef_pred <= 0, na.rm = TRUE),
  mean(results$coef_pred >= 0, na.rm = TRUE)
)
  # Output
  cat("==================================================\n")
  cat("Full Model Summary:\n")
  print(summary(model2))
  cat("\n==================================================\n")
  cat("ANOVA: Covariates vs Full Model\n")
  print(anova(model1, model2))
  cat("\n==================================================\n")
  cat("Bootstrapping Results (", n_iter, " iterations):\n", sep = "")
  cat("Mean R² Difference: ", mean(results$r2_diff), "\n")
  cat("Mean Adjusted R² Difference: ", mean(results$adjr2_diff), "\n")
  cat("Mean Coefficient for ", predictor, ": ", mean(results$coef_pred), "\n", sep = "")
  cat("95% CI for Coefficient: [", 
      quantile(results$coef_pred, 0.025), ", ",
      quantile(results$coef_pred, 0.975), "]\n", sep = "")
  cat("p-value (coef <= 0): ", pval, "\n")
}


covars <- c("ICV", "mom_education")
```

#Make plots for significant models

```{r, message=FALSE, warning=FALSE}

Processed <- df

# Fit multiple regression models for each dependent variable
model_IL1RA_2 <- lm(IL1RA_2 ~ ICV + mom_education, data = Processed, na.action = na.exclude)
model_STNFRII_1 <- lm(STNFRII_1 ~ ICV + mom_education, data = Processed, na.action = na.exclude)
model_IL8_2 <- lm(IL8_2 ~ ICV + mom_education, data = Processed, na.action = na.exclude)
model_l_vta_hipp <- lm(l_vta_hipp_count.log ~ ICV + mom_education, data = Processed, na.action = na.exclude)
model_r_vta_hipp <- lm(r_vta_hipp_count.log ~ ICV + mom_education, data = Processed, na.action = na.exclude)
model_l_vta_limbic <- lm(l_vta_limbic_count.log ~ ICV + mom_education, data = Processed, na.action = na.exclude)
model_r_vta_limbic <- lm(r_vta_limbic_count.log ~ ICV + mom_education, data = Processed, na.action = na.exclude)

# Extract residuals and store them in the dataset
Processed$residuals_IL1RA_2 <- resid(model_IL1RA_2)
Processed$residuals_STNFRII_1 <- resid(model_STNFRII_1)
Processed$residuals_IL8_2 <- resid(model_IL8_2)
Processed$residuals_l_vta_hipp <- resid(model_l_vta_hipp)
Processed$residuals_r_vta_hipp <- resid(model_r_vta_hipp)
Processed$residuals_l_vta_limbic <- resid(model_l_vta_limbic)
Processed$residuals_r_vta_limbic <- resid(model_r_vta_limbic)

# Load necessary libraries
library(ggplot2)
library(patchwork)  # For arranging multiple plots
library(grid)

# Rename columns in Processed dataset for clarity
Processed <- Processed %>%
rename(
  `Trimester 2 IL-1ra` = residuals_IL1RA_2,
  `Trimester 1 sTNF-RII` = residuals_STNFRII_1,
  `Trimester 2 IL-8` = residuals_IL8_2,
  `Left VTA-Hippocampus` = residuals_l_vta_hipp,
  `Right VTA-Hippocampus` = residuals_r_vta_hipp,
  `Left VTA-Limbic Striatum` = residuals_l_vta_limbic,
  `Right VTA-Limbic Striatum` = residuals_r_vta_limbic,
 )

# Create scatter plots with regression lines and no title

p1 <- ggplot(Processed, aes(x = `Trimester 2 IL-1ra`, y = `Left VTA-Hippocampus`)) +
geom_point() +
geom_smooth(method = "lm", se = FALSE, color = "blue") +
labs(y = "Left VTA–Hippocampus") +
theme_bw() +
theme(
  axis.text = element_text(size = 12),
  axis.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold")
)
```
